title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo al la Gestin del Comercio Exterior

description.narrative: Contribuir a mejorar el proceso de insercin econmica internacional del pas a travs del fortalecimiento de la capacidad institucional del sector pblico y privado en materia de negociacin, implementacin y administracin de las polticas comerciales y de insercin econmica internacional as como de promocin de exportaciones y atraccin de inversiones.

To foster the country's process of international economic integration through institutional capacity-building in the public and private sectors in the areas of negotiation, implementation, and administration of trade and international economic integration policies, as well as policies to promote exports and attract investment.
